verdict.rationale: FireHydrant publishes a first-party API reference under docs.firehydrant.com/reference, including an API overview page and per-endpoint pages such as list_signals_webhook_targets. An OpenAPI 3.0.1 document is also published in the official MCP repo. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples, and probes of standard OpenAPI paths on the docs site returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request/response examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec on the docs site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
